title: TRICARE Select Corrected Inpatient Stay - Payment Worksheet
content:
**Scope.** This worksheet applies to the corrected stay of a **TRICARE Select** enrollee who is the only member of the sponsor family enrolled in Select, read from the enrollee's own Select enrollment carrying the family's fee billing under an individual fee arrangement, whose Select enrollment took effect in the plan year that contains the adjudication date, and who holds no TRICARE Prime enrollment or exactly one that took effect in that same plan year, so that the family's deductible and catastrophic totals are the enrollee's own and every claim line and every installment whose coverage period has begun on that enrollment, and every Prime claim line and Prime installment of the enrollee, belongs to that calendar plan year; for any other enrollee it settles nothing. A fee-exempt enrollment carries no fee arrangement from which the family's Select membership can be read, so the fee-exempt tiers (the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers) are outside this calculation by design. Plan years are calendar years of 12 months, reckoned on the calendar from 2000-01-01.

## Lines of the worksheet

| Line | Entry |
|---|---|
| A. Covered days | every billed inpatient day of the corrected stay is covered |
| B. Payable allowed amount | an inpatient mental health stay is priced by the day, so its payable allowed amount is the reversed line's allowed amount times the covered days divided by the billed days, rounded to the cent; any other corrected stay is payable at the reversed line's full allowed amount when it has a covered day and not at all otherwise |
| C. Amount cost-shared on | with other health insurance on file, the payable allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, never below zero; otherwise the payable allowed amount |
| D. Beneficiary liability | the tier's network admission copayment, charged once for the stay; a corrected stay with no covered day carries no beneficiary liability |
| E. TRICARE payment | TRICARE pays as primary payer: the payable allowed amount less the beneficiary liability that amount carries, rounded to the cent and never below zero |

## Worked worksheets (hypothetical)

| Tier | Stay | B | D | E |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B (network admission copayment 201.00) | acute admission, 4 days, allowed 8000.00 | 8000.00 | 201.00 | 7799.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A (network admission copayment 0.00) | inpatient mental health stay, 9 days billed, allowed 7200.00 | 7200.00 times 9 divided by 9: 7200.00 | 0.00 | 7200.00 |
